record.context_brief: Stability parameter for real phase retrieval
record.original_question: For a real matrix A ∈ R^{(2M−1)×M}, define ω(A) = min_{S ⊆ [N] : rank(A_{S^c}) < M} σ_M(A_S), where A_S is the submatrix formed by the rows indexed by S and σ_M denotes the smallest singular value. Suppose every subset of M rows of A spans R^M. Do there exist universal constants C > 0 and 0 < β < 1 such that ω(A) ≤ C max_{k ∈ [N]} ||A_k||^β for every such A, where A_k is the k-th row?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 20. There exist universal constants C > 0 and 0 < β < 1 such that, for any M > 1 and A ∈ R^{2M−1×M} a matrix for which any subset of M rows spans R^M, ω(A) ≤ C max_{k∈[N]} ||A_k||^β_M.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let M > 1 be an integer and set N = 2M − 1. For a real matrix A ∈ R^{N×M} with rows A_1, …, A_N ∈ R^M, and for any subset S ⊆ [N] := {1, …, N}, let A_S denote the submatrix of A formed by the rows indexed by S, and let σ_M(A_S) denote the smallest singular value of A_S (with σ_M(A_S) := 0 if A_S has fewer than M rows). Let S^c = [N] \ S. Define
   ω(A) = min { σ_M(A_S) : S ⊆ [N] and rank(A_{S^c}) < M }.
Assume A has the property that every subset of M of its rows spans R^M (equivalently, A satisfies the "complement property" ensuring injectivity of the squared-magnitude measurement map).

Question: Do there exist universal constants C > 0 and 0 < β < 1 (independent of M and of A) such that, for every M > 1 and every such matrix A ∈ R^{(2M−1)×M},
   ω(A) ≤ C · max_{k ∈ [N]} ‖A_k‖^β,
where ‖·‖ denotes the Euclidean norm on R^M?
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture (attributed to Balan and Wang, 2013) concerns stability of real phase retrieval at the critical measurement number N = 2M − 1. The Randomstrasse 101 problem page states it remains open and that the author is unaware of progress resolving it. No published resolution was found in the search.

status_evidence.title: Injectivity and Stability of Phase Retrieval (problems 19-21) | Randomstrasse 101
status_evidence.snippet: This also motivates the following question (for which I do not know the state of the art, but a quick search did not reveal that the answer is already known).
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is presented as open, with no known resolution.

status_evidence.title: Saving phase: Injectivity and stability for phase retrieval (Balan–Wang)
status_evidence.snippet: Stability bounds for real phase retrieval involving smallest singular values over partitions of rows.
status_evidence.claim: Origin of the framework underlying the conjecture about ω(A).
